variants.headline: Home-world ship reaches the colony
variants.sub: The colony has received the arrival of a home-world ship.
variants.body:
A ship from the home world has arrived in {colony}. The arrival is a concrete event in the colony's connection with its distant origin. Readers considering {target} should distinguish that fact from assumptions about particular goods, passengers or immediate changes in local supply not specified in this report.

The gazette records the arrival without presuming the contents of the vessel. A notice of a ship reaching the colony should not be enlarged into an account of deliveries or administrative arrangements not supplied here. The event has sufficient public significance without adding particulars to its official description.

We welcome {target} in this assessment. A tangible connection with the home world deserves recognition, while a fair account can acknowledge the arrival without pretending that every need has thereby been satisfied. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.
